column1: # FOSS reuse decision of recipe mat-sortable-processor-20261107 (M3 FOSS donor-first gate). Search: the OpenCLAW org (gh repo list openclaw, 97 repositories, inventoried 2026-11-07 by the static-use leaf) has no annotation processor, comparator generator or source-time schema sealer; M3JDK master b93686c9c2f7 carries the OpenJDK javac sources, Lombok-style generators only as donor references (no Lombok source is vendored), and the structural-signal processor of m3/collections/signal-codegen (DECISION.tsv S3). The donor is first-party Synexia code (Apache-2.0, Copyright 2026 Hitesh Soliwal and contributors).

column8: Lombok rewrites the annotated class through javac internals; the donor writes a separate companion through the portable Filer API and never mutates the annotated type (its Javadoc names Lombok as the style, not the mechanism)
